scope: Quick savanna tuft study, sparse C; no tree source or protected biome changes
camera: fixed existing human-height hero and elevated inspection

history.observation: Fine fans reduce chip noise but remain mostly around rock; weak framing.
More substantial hero silhouette, but broad upright ribbons in close-up.
Tall arched tips catch light, but dense continuous sides form artificial hedge rows.
150 broken asymmetric foreground clumps restore opening, height variation and lit curved tips; root color matches ground more closely. Still reed-like and not perfectly natural.

notes: Presentation dressing only; no source trees or ecological records modified.
World-space plant masses and correlated ground albedo; no screen vignette.
Existing hero tree receives selective sun-facing crown highlights.
